metadata.description: TPC-H Query to Policy Mapping - TIERED ARCHITECTURE (No Cycles)
metadata.rule: Policy on tier N can only reference tables from tier < N

customer.description: Customers from EUROPE or AMERICA regions with positive balance
customer.raw_sql:
SELECT c.*
FROM customer c
WHERE c.c_acctbal > 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM nation n, region r
    WHERE n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
      AND n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
      AND r.r_name IN ('EUROPE', 'AMERICA')
  )
customer.predicate:
c.c_acctbal > 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM nation n, region r
    WHERE n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
      AND n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
      AND r.r_name IN ('EUROPE', 'AMERICA')
  )

supplier.description: Suppliers from EUROPE with positive balance
supplier.raw_sql:
SELECT s.*
FROM supplier s
WHERE s.s_acctbal > 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM nation n, region r
    WHERE n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
      AND n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
      AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  )
supplier.predicate:
s.s_acctbal > 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM nation n, region r
    WHERE n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
      AND n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
      AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  )

partsupp.description: Partsupp from suppliers with positive balance and sufficient stock
partsupp.raw_sql:
SELECT ps.*
FROM partsupp ps
WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 100
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM supplier s
    WHERE s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
      AND s.s_acctbal > 0
  )
partsupp.predicate:
ps.ps_availqty > 100
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM supplier s
    WHERE s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
      AND s.s_acctbal > 0
  )

lineitem.description: Lineitem from high-priority orders with available partsupp
lineitem.raw_sql:
SELECT l.*
FROM lineitem l
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
      AND o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM partsupp ps
    WHERE ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey
      AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
      AND ps.ps_availqty > 0
  )
lineitem.predicate:
EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
      AND o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM partsupp ps
    WHERE ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey
      AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
      AND ps.ps_availqty > 0
  )

dependency_chains.lineitem: lineitem -> orders (no policy) + partsupp(p4) -> supplier(p2) -> nation/region (STOPS at Tier 0)
